headline: The kettle clicks off alone.
body: The room has cooled at the floorboards. A cup left on the radiator has a dry rim. Outside, one engine goes by and does not come back.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: low pale strip, uneven, not yet day

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: one van, then the quiet again

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: lamp still on, glass catching grey
